button.label: Alert
button.supertip: Cycles the selection: alert 1 (three weights up, Accent 1), then alert 2 (two weights up, Accent 2), then back to the level's own look.

button.label: Bolder
button.supertip: Two weights up in the same family, colour untouched. Press again to return to the level's weight. Uses the real heavier face, never a synthesised bold.

button.label: Smaller
button.supertip: Gives the selection the look of the next level deeper (size, weight, lightness) without indenting it. Each press goes one level deeper; after level 5 it returns to the paragraph's own look.

toggleButton.label: Watch
toggleButton.supertip: Keeps alert colours at the level of the bullet they are on. Promote or demote a line and the colour is put right when the cursor leaves the box. Only alerted text is touched, and only its colour and weight; the words are left alone. The correction cannot be undone with Ctrl+Z.

button.label: Fix Alerts
button.supertip: Goes through every slide and puts each alert at the colour its bullet level asks for. For decks edited while Watch was off.
